packages.name: @velaros-ai/agent
packages.description: Host-agnostic agent loop, prompt, orchestration, team, execution, and tool runtime for VelarOS-compatible hosts.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/cli
packages.description: VelarOS 官方命令行发行包：velaros 可执行文件与可嵌入的运维命名空间路由器。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/development
packages.description: Project 代码理解背后的语言服务库：JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Python 的即时导航与诊断。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/core
packages.description: VelarOS 跨领域共享基础工具：断言、错误、结果、类型守卫与无领域语义的通用原语。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/platform
packages.description: Cross-platform conventions for VelarOS hosts: path text, shells, process commands, app and data directories, and the VelarOS shared resource roots.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/agent-lab
packages.description: 可复现的连续旅程评测：诊断、统计与认证，连同 velaros-agent-lab 命令行；不认宿主。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/code-surface
packages.description: Code surface for capability spaces: the model writes a JavaScript ES module that imports generated capability declarations, the program is typechecked before it runs, and it executes in an isolated process whose only reachable capabilities are the host operations it calls back into.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/path-rules
packages.description: Path rules shared by capability spaces: glob matching with directory-prefix semantics, .gitignore parsing and evaluation (negation, anchoring, directory-only, character classes), traversal ignore policy backed by git itself when available, and the directory names traversal skips by default.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/text-files
packages.description: Lossless text files on disk for capability spaces: encoding detection (UTF-8, UTF-16 with or without BOM, GB18030), strict decoding, encoding back to the original bytes, atomic replacement that keeps permissions and links, and bounded or streaming reads.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/tool-contract
packages.description: The tool contract shared by capability spaces: declare a tool once (identity, category, role, permissions, capability schema, exposure), render and police its model-facing description, turn its zod schema into JSON Schema or a compact bundle, mount a whole space onto the kernel, and build the one failure envelope every space reports.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/velar
packages.description: The capability units the model imports as velar:* modules and every space mounts with its own port (products assemble the spaces; each unit's ./local entry gives its port on this machine): files (machine files, system space; with the machine file port and a global search for host UIs underneath), images (view pictures within provider limits; with the machine image port, sips on macOS), shell (run commands; with the local machine host underneath: background tasks, interactive consoles, shell selection, process confinement, the Windows process host, and the processes, ports and metrics a host UI shows), sandbox (rehearse in a mirror, then apply; with the local rehearsal sandbox underneath), project (governed project files and code questions: velar:project and velar:code, with the project kernel and its transactions underneath, and the ports a project hands to shell, sandbox and images), computer (desktop control: screenshots, pointer, keyboard, with the helper sidecar runtime underneath), memory (long-term memory: one directory of Markdown files per host-given scope, plus the index a host puts at the start of each session), office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel generation, PDF reading and editing, Word and LaTeX to PDF, document preview and Markdown conversion, with the document engines underneath and the narrow renderer primitives the Document Renderer uses) and browser (velar:browser to drive and read pages, velar:devtools for console, network, storage, performance, recording, emulation and user scripts, with the CDP drivers, page engines, Electron session runtime and site workspace underneath). One plain directory per unit, one convention for all.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/html-artifacts
packages.description: A framework-neutral streaming HTML artifact protocol and sandboxed iframe runtime.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/kernel
packages.description: VelarOS library-first microkernel: contracts, in-process runtime, thin client, and optional serve deployment.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/model
packages.description: Model provider adapters, provider script integration, and runtime model resolution for VelarOS-compatible hosts.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/surface-protocol
packages.description: provider 自持代理面（Agent Surface）的线格式合同：带版本、不认宿主。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/ui
packages.description: A reusable React component library with accessible primitives, application shells, and design tokens, plus the host-agnostic conversation UI (message blocks, tool renderers, stream pacing) under ./conversation.
